title: Japan and the U.S. intervene jointly to stem the yen's fall
summary: The yen surges against the dollar after Tokyo and Washington confirmed coordinated currency purchases and warned of further action against speculation.

title: Japanese and South Korean markets fall sharply on chips and profit-taking
summary: The KOSPI loses more than 4% on selling of Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, while the Nikkei retreats as much as 1,200 points dragged down by profit-taking.

title: AI and semiconductor investments suffer heavy losses in July
summary: Nvidia corrects from its highs, technology stocks reverse their trend, and an AI fund loses 67% in the month.

title: AstraZeneca and Bristol Myers Squibb reportedly held talks on a $400 billion megamerger
summary: The report, published by the Financial Times and citing sources, points to one of the biggest deals in the pharmaceutical industry, although there is no official confirmation.

title: Fed holds rates at 3.5% for second straight meeting under Kevin Warsh
summary: Three committee members dissented and the chairman's communication unsettles long-bond investors.

title: Trump confirms new talks with Iran as Tehran says they are in the final phase
summary: Trump plans to speak with Iran on the 3rd about the Strait of Hormuz and the nuclear program, while Tehran says consultations with Oman are in the final phase and Wall Street futures react higher.

title: Oil falls on expectations of more supply and progress in talks with Iran
summary: Crude retreats in Asian markets as OPEC+ agrees to raise production targets and negotiations between the U.S. and Iran resume.

title: Strong earnings from big U.S. companies underpin the stock market rally
summary: The largest U.S. companies post very solid profits despite rising costs for consumers, which strengthens stock markets.

title: U.S. July jobs report will set the agenda for markets next week
summary: Investors await U.S. payroll data to assess whether the Federal Reserve should rethink the path of interest rates.
